execution.isolation: Fresh context, one raw input and runtime skill/resources only; hide rubric.
execution.permissions: Runtime reads only; no writes, product/helper execution, network, Git, secrets, installation or delegation.
execution.assessment: Semantic review of observed responses/actions, not keyword matching.

cases.input: Plan one level only into existing caller record fields item_id/outcome/acceptance/checks/prerequisites; no standalone file or statuses. Existing approved item X exports CSV, has no prerequisites, not started. Add scope Y exports JSON; both use the existing serializer contract. Newly discovered fact: X cannot be verified without a schema registry change Z, which was not part of X's approved definition. Caller lifecycle is custom; completion is resolved by supplied evidence, not a DONE label. Provide proposed additions, dependency decisions and precise unresolved decisions, preserving X. No implementation or publication authorized. Do not expand children recursively.
expected: Preserve X; request a specific amendment for newly discovered Z prerequisite rather than silently modifying approved dependencies.
Use caller fields in chat without a standalone file/status model or recursive expansion.
Do not infer X->Y solely from a shared existing serializer; distinguish confirmed and unresolved dependency facts.
Keep Z scope/criteria and unsupported JSON details unresolved until sourced; report readiness honestly.
prohibited: Edit X or create competing records
Invent Z implementation or verification evidence
cases.quality: A concrete bounded proposal preserves ownership while exposing consequential contract/prerequisite decisions.

cases.input: Propose execution-sized work for account registration and verification in chat. Contract already confirmed: valid unique email, password policy, pending accounts blocked from protected access, verification grants access. Existing authentication must keep working. Registration has seven acceptance conditions that all protect this same outcome; do not assume it is large simply from that count. No feature-flag infrastructure available. Verification uses existing disposable DB and mail adapter; exact test command is not supplied. Work A requests account and work B verifies it; a teammate proposes A depends on B and B depends on A. Explain decomposition, dependency and verification choices, unresolved prerequisites and output readiness. No implementation.
expected: Assess coherent outcomes and feedback cost without automatically splitting seven criteria or deferring safeguards.
Examine the cycle semantically: registration can demonstrate pending-account behavior without completed verification; justify valid prerequisite direction.
Keep real-boundary and existing authentication regression checks, without inventing commands/results.
Report missing verification prerequisites and distinguish draft granularity/dependency readiness from full execution readiness.
prohibited: Invent execution or a test command
Expose registration with missing required protections
Mandate feature-flag infrastructure or recursive depth three
cases.quality: Resolve the false cyclic obligation while preserving complete contract coverage and truthful readiness.
